plugins.name: 7it-guard
plugins.description: Checks a deployed web app from the outside before it ships, on your own machine: HTTPS and security headers, a public source map, email authentication, speed, accessibility, SEO and reliability, plus exposed files, keys in the browser code and the Supabase or Firebase backend once you confirm the app is yours. One graded, prioritized report.

metadata.description: 7IT Guard: one prioritized pre-launch report for a deployed web app, run on your own machine.
